name: CSR Generator
description: Generate a PKCS#10 certificate signing request, with key usage presets per certificate type.

examples.label: Generate a server CSR with an existing test key

hints.san: One entry per line or comma-separated, for example `DNS:a.example.com` or `IP:10.0.0.1`.
hints.private: A newly generated private key is returned **only once** — store it immediately.
hints.challenge: The challenge password is only used for verification; the response reports whether it is **present**, never its value.

faq.a: No. Validity is decided when the CA issues the certificate.

faq.q: Why offer "use an existing private key"?
faq.a: Renewals normally reuse the key so already deployed trust does not have to be rebuilt.

faq.q: Will the CA honour the SANs in my CSR?
faq.a: Most CAs check them, so do not put names that do not belong to you.
